title: Review of Safe Management Measures at Workplace
what_it_is: Review of Safe Management Measures at Workplace

sections.label: Deferred workplace SMM updates
sections.summary: Tripartite partners deferred workplace SMM updates; the Task Force will monitor COVID-19 after Chinese New Year, with work-from-home remaining default and at most 50% of employees at the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The tripartite partners decided to defer any updates to the SMMs for the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Multi-Ministry Task Force will monitor the COVID-19 situation for a few weeks after the Chinese New Year period to assess when public health measures, including SMMs for the workplace, can be adjusted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Adjustments to SMMs for the workplace will consider the public health risk, level of community cases, as well as employee and business interests.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For now, work-from-home remains the default working arrangement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employers must ensure that no more than 50% of employees who are able to work from home are at the workplace at any point in time, and that these employees work from home for at least half their working time.

sections.label: Monitoring guided by Task Force
sections.summary: The speaker says monitoring continues and they stand guided by the Multi-Ministry Task Force, which will review a few weeks after the Chinese New Year period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Therefore, we are constantly monitoring, and as I mentioned in my earlier response, we stand guided by the Multi-Ministry Task Force.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: They will review a few weeks after the Chinese New Year period.

sections.label: Vaccination and workplace SMMs
sections.summary: Until enough people are vaccinated, vaccinated employees should continue public health measures like Workplace SMMs, while vaccine protection duration and transmission effectiveness are monitored.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the Member's question on whether vaccination will play a role in our measures, the key thing is this, until enough people are vaccinated, vaccinated employees should continue to practice public health measures such as Workplace SMMs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We are still monitoring the duration of the vaccine's protection and its effectiveness in preventing transmission of COVID-19.
